events.title: Claude@Stanford Kickoff
events.place: At Stanford. You get the room when you RSVP.
events.summary: Our first meeting of the year. Meet other Stanford students who want to build with AI and hear what the club has planned, then build something real in a beginner-friendly Claude Code workshop. Show and tell at the end.
notes: Free boba while supplies last, and Claude hats for the first 20 people through the door.
Bring a laptop, a charger and your Stanford email, which you need for API credits.
All majors and skill levels are welcome. You don’t need to know how to code.
